text: How does the merchant's server learn that a payment is paid?
prefix: How does the merchant's server learn that a payment is paid?

text: The shop needs to know before it ships the goods.
prefix: The shop needs to know before it ships the goods.

text: Its server might be down for an hour, and still needs every event when it comes back, in order.
prefix: Its server might be down for an hour, and still needs every event when it comes back, in order.

text: It must also tell a real event from a forged one.
prefix: It must also tell a real event from a forged one.

text: Anyone can send a message that says paid.
prefix: Anyone can send a message that says paid.

text: And there is a danger for the bank.
prefix: And there is a danger for the bank.

text: An attacker could set their webhook address to a server inside the bank's own network, and make ecom call it.
prefix: An attacker could set their webhook address to a server inside the bank's own network, and make ecom call it.

text: Think of a registered letter.
prefix: Think of a registered letter.

text: It is sealed, so the reader knows who sent it.
prefix: It is sealed, so the reader knows who sent it.

text: It goes only to a real street address.
prefix: It goes only to a real street address.

text: If nobody is home, the postman comes back later.
prefix: If nobody is home, the postman comes back later.

text: And after a while, the letter is marked as returned.
prefix: And after a while, the letter is marked as returned.

text: A webhook is that letter.
prefix: A webhook is that letter.

text: When the news about a payment leaves the outbox, ecom posts it to the website's webhook address.
prefix: When the news about a payment leaves the outbox, ecom posts it to the website's webhook address.

text: That address is set by the merchant for each website.
prefix: That address is set by the merchant for each website.

text: Every event carries its own id, the time it was sent, and a webhook signature.
prefix: Every event carries its own id, the time it was sent, and a webhook signature.

text: The signature is made with the same signing key as the merchant's API client.
prefix: The signature is made with the same signing key as the merchant's API client.

text: It follows a common open standard, so any webhook library can check it.
prefix: It follows a common open standard, so any webhook library can check it.

text: The merchant's server checks the seal, drops events that are too old, and drops any id it has seen before.
prefix: The merchant's server checks the seal, drops events that are too old, and drops any id it has seen before.

text: Before connecting, ecom checks the address.
prefix: Before connecting, ecom checks the address.

text: It must be a secure address.
prefix: It must be a secure address.

text: It must lead only to the public internet.
prefix: It must lead only to the public internet.

text: And it is checked again at the very moment of connecting, so it cannot change in between.
prefix: And it is checked again at the very moment of connecting, so it cannot change in between.

text: Redirects are not followed.
prefix: Redirects are not followed.

text: This guard stops server-side request forgery: a trick where someone makes a server call places it should never reach.
prefix: This guard stops server-side request forgery: a trick where someone makes a server call places it should never reach.

text: A delivery succeeds only when the merchant's server answers with success.
prefix: A delivery succeeds only when the merchant's server answers with success.

text: Anything else is tried again, waiting longer each time.
prefix: Anything else is tried again, waiting longer each time.

text: A payment's later events wait behind an earlier one, so they stay in order.
prefix: A payment's later events wait behind an earlier one, so they stay in order.

text: After the bank's chosen time, an event that never got through is marked undelivered.
prefix: After the bank's chosen time, an event that never got through is marked undelivered.

text: The merchant can then ask for it again.
prefix: The merchant can then ask for it again.

text: Payment links get no webhooks, because there is no server behind them.
prefix: Payment links get no webhooks, because there is no server behind them.

text: Now watch the product.
prefix: Now watch the product.

text: In the merchant portal, open a payment.
prefix: In the merchant portal, open a payment.

text: Below its calls to the card scheme is a section called webhooks.
prefix: Below its calls to the card scheme is a section called webhooks.

text: Each event shows its type and its status.
prefix: Each event shows its type and its status.

text: Here it says delivered, after one attempt, with the last answer from the merchant's server.
prefix: Here it says delivered, after one attempt, with the last answer from the merchant's server.

text: Now take the merchant's server offline, and make a new payment.
prefix: Now take the merchant's server offline, and make a new payment.

text: Its event says retrying, with the time of the next attempt and the last answer, which is no answer.
prefix: Its event says retrying, with the time of the next attempt and the last answer, which is no answer.

text: A later event for the same payment says waiting for an earlier event.
prefix: A later event for the same payment says waiting for an earlier event.

text: While an event is still retrying, there is no button to send it again.
prefix: While an event is still retrying, there is no button to send it again.

text: In the end, it says undelivered.
prefix: In the end, it says undelivered.

text: The hint says the server never answered with success, and asks the merchant to fix it, then send the event again.
prefix: The hint says the server never answered with success, and asks the merchant to fix it, then send the event again.

text: The merchant brings the server back, and presses send again.
prefix: The merchant brings the server back, and presses send again.

text: A short note says it is queued and goes out within seconds.
prefix: A short note says it is queued and goes out within seconds.

text: The status turns to delivered.
prefix: The status turns to delivered.

text: Open a payment made from a link, and the section says no webhook was sent: the website has no webhook address, or it is a payment link.
prefix: Open a payment made from a link, and the section says no webhook was sent: the website has no webhook address, or it is a payment link.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: The signature protects the merchant from a forged paid.
prefix: The signature protects the merchant from a forged paid.

text: The retries protect the merchant from losing news during an outage.
prefix: The retries protect the merchant from losing news during an outage.

text: The order protects against seeing refunded before paid.
prefix: The order protects against seeing refunded before paid.

text: And the address guard protects the bank's own network from its own webhooks.
prefix: And the address guard protects the bank's own network from its own webhooks.

text: So back to the registered letter.
prefix: So back to the registered letter.

text: Sealed, sent only to a real address, and tried again until it arrives.
prefix: Sealed, sent only to a real address, and tried again until it arrives.

text: Next: payments without a website.
prefix: Next: payments without a website.
